metadata.name: Exponential IF
metadata.author: Fourcaud-Trocmé, N. et al.
metadata.description: Deterministic EIF current balance from Equations 6 and 10 with the paper's finite +30 mV simulation cutoff

dynamics.v: (-(min(v, v_threshold) - v_rest) + delta_t * exp((min(v, v_threshold) - v_rh) / delta_t) + I) / tau

extensions.current_convention: I is normalised by leak conductance
extensions.finite_cutoff: 30 mV, following the source simulation protocol
